source: original (technique drill: solve b^x = c with calculator, 3 s.f.)

parts.label: a
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form x = log_3(17) or log(17)/log(3) for full credit. Numerical: 2.58 (3 s.f.). Accept 2.579 with rounding mention.
parts.notes: M1 for taking a logarithm of both sides (any base) or rewriting as x = log_3(17). A1 for the numerical value 2.58 to 3 s.f.

parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form x = 2 + log_4(30) or 2 + log(30)/log(4). Numerical: 4.45 (3 s.f.).
parts.notes: M1 for (x-2) log 4 = log 30 (or equivalent log step). A1 for x = 4.45 (3 s.f.).

parts.label: c
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form x = (log_2(100) - 1)/3 or (2/log(2) - 1)/3. Numerical: 1.88 (3 s.f.).
parts.notes: M1 for (3x+1) log 2 = log 100. A1 for x = 1.88 (3 s.f.).

parts.label: d
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form x = log(7) / (log(7) - log(5)) or x = log_(7/5)(7). Numerical: 5.79 (3 s.f.). Sign-error mid-computation that yields 5.79 still receives both marks since the final value is correct.
parts.notes: M1 for taking log of both sides AND collecting x-terms: x(log 7 - log 5) = log 7 (or equivalent). A1 for x = 5.79 (3 s.f.). The M1 covers both the take-log step and the collect-terms step since they're inseparable for this equation.

parts.label: b
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=24 to get 200 * 3^2.4. A1 for 2793 (or 2794 if rounding differs).

parts.label: c
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form t = 10 log_3(25) or 10 log(25)/log(3). Numerical: 29.3 (1 d.p.).
parts.notes: M1 for setting up 200 * 3^(t/10) = 5000. A1 for isolating 3^(t/10) = 25. M1 for taking log to get t/10 = log(25)/log(3). A1 for t = 29.3 (1 d.p.).

parts.label: a
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form 50 * 2^(-2.5) or 50/(4*sqrt(2)). Numerical: 8.84 g (3 s.f.); accept also 8.839 with rounding.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=20 into 50 * (0.5)^(t/8) to get 50 * (0.5)^2.5. A1 for 8.84 g (3 s.f.). Units 'g' or 'grams' should be present but absence is not penalised here.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Time when 60% has decayed (40% remains), 3 s.f.
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form t = 8 log(0.4)/log(0.5) or 8 log_(1/2)(0.4). Numerical: 10.6 days (3 s.f.).
parts.notes: M1 for recognising 40% remains (i.e. M(t) = 20) and writing (0.5)^(t/8) = 0.40. M1 for taking log of both sides to isolate t/8. A1 for t = 10.6 days (3 s.f.).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Time when only 1 g remains, nearest day
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form t = 8 log(0.02)/log(0.5) or 8 log_2(50). Numerical: 45 days (or 45.15... rounded). 46 days only if candidate has rounded their intermediate value differently.
parts.notes: M1 for setting up (0.5)^(t/8) = 1/50 = 0.02. A1 for t ≈ 45 days (rounded from 45.15...).

parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Accept 33.4°C (3 s.f.) or 33.38 with rounding mention.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=15 into 20 + 65*(0.9)^15. A1 for 33.4°C (3 s.f.).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Time at which T = 40 C, 3 s.f.
parts.tolerance: Accept exact form t = log(4/13)/log(0.9) or log(20/65)/log(0.9). Numerical: 11.2 minutes (3 s.f.).
parts.notes: M1 for setting T(t) = 40 and isolating (0.9)^t = 20/65 = 4/13. M1 for taking log of both sides. A1 for t = 11.2 minutes (3 s.f.).
